opportunities.title: Junior Scientist Conference Grants

deadlines.raw: 1st day of February, April, June, August, October and December

amount.raw: Grants up to £200 are available for travel and essential overnight accommodation to attend any of the Genetics Society’s own meetings and those of our Special Interest Groups (SIGs). Grants of up to £500 are available to attend conferences in the area of Genetics, which are not run by the Genetics Society or one of their SIGs. Grants of up to £300 are available to cover registration costs for virtual conferences.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Scheme (A) is open to undergraduate, Master’s and PhD student members and to postdoctoral scientist members of The Society within six years of their PhD viva. Scientists who obtained their PhD more than six years ago are not eligible for this scheme. Schemes (B) & (C) are open to PhD student and postdoctoral scientist members within six years of their PhD viva (but not undergraduate or Master’s students). Scientists who obtained their PhD more than six years ago are not eligible for these schemes.
opportunities.summary: The purpose of these grants is to support the attendance of Genetics Society “junior scientist” members at conferences on research in Genetics. The scheme has three main streams: (A) to support attendance at meetings organised directly by the Genetics Society or sponsored by the Society as a Special Interest Group (SIG); (B) to support attendance at non-Genetics Society meetings; and (C) to support attendance of virtual conferences.

opportunities.title: Training Grant

deadlines.raw: quarterly, at midnight on 15th February, May, August and November

opportunities.eligibility_summary: All members of the Genetics Society can apply, as long as you are studying or working in the UK, or the course you wish to attend is being held in the UK. Students can apply as soon as they become Society members. Others should be a Society member for at least one year.
opportunities.summary: The Genetics Society can help with grants of up to £1,200 to enable members to attend formal short training courses, or a collaborative visit to another laboratory to train in specific genetic/genomic techniques.

opportunities.title: Summer Studentship

amount.raw: £425/week allowance for up to 8 weeks, Up to £750 to cover host laboratory expenses, A place on the 2-3 day expenses paid* student Summer School Workshop

opportunities.eligibility_summary: The Summer Studentship scheme is open to all undergraduate students, except those in their first or final year. The project must be based at a UK university.
opportunities.summary: Grants available to support undergraduate students to gain experience in any area of genetics by doing a research project during the summer holiday prior to the final year of their degree.

opportunities.title: Research Access Placements

amount.raw: £425/week for up to 8 weeks, Flexible allowance of £160, Up to £750 to cover research costs

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any undergraduate student from an underrepresented background. This includes, but is not limited to, being a member of a minoritised group, being in receipt of the full amount of student loan, having a declared disability, having refugee status, or having caring responsibilities.
opportunities.summary: Grants available to support undergraduate students from underrepresented and/or minoritised backgrounds in the biosciences to undertake a fully paid summer placement in a research lab.

opportunities.title: Communicating Your Science Workshop

amount.raw: The Genetics Society will cover travel (within the UK only), accommodation and meals for successful applicants.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: The course is open to PhD student and postdoctoral researcher Society members working in genetics and related areas.
opportunities.summary: A workshop to help participants explore and develop their communication skills in different fields.

opportunities.title: Carer’s Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any member can apply, regardless of age of person they are caring for.
opportunities.summary: An award of (up to) £60/day to be used as you think will best support your attendance.

opportunities.title: One-off Meeting

amount.raw: Several levels of sponsorship are possible. We can sponsor a specific Genetics Society lecture for a few hundred pounds or a Genetics Society session for up to about £1,000. As major sponsor of an entire meeting we can potentially sponsor several thousand pounds but the costs need to be well justified.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members may apply at any time of the year.
opportunities.summary: Sponsorship of genetic themed meetings not organised directly by the Genetics Society.

opportunities.title: Public Engagement
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All society members are eligible to apply.
opportunities.summary: Grants of up to £1,000 are available to members of the Genetics Society to support public engagement activities related to genetics.

opportunities.title: New Special Interest Group
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All society members are eligible to apply.
opportunities.summary: Funding up to £2,000 per year is available for genetics research communities who wish to run regular series of meetings.
